$comment: Sizes are world pixels (320 x 180 view). Painted files are 4x. See content/README.md. The costume was designed on 2026-09-27: see bull-leaper.md.

assets.what: The tourist in chapter 3's costume: a costume-shop bull-leaper kit (wig held on by a sweatband, a belt slipped to his hips, a kilt) over his running kit. Four frames: idle, walk1, walk2, jump.
The same, the wig knocked down over his eyes. Used, stretched and rotated, by every death but the throne.
Sitting on the floor with the wig off in his lap: the 'Gave up' pose.
Sitting in the throne at Knossos, facing out, at rest. The one death in the game with no physical cause.
